hero_kpi_rationale: Primary performance indicator in the banking sector, reflecting the efficiency of interest-earning assets and liabilities management. The 10 basis point improvement to 2.06% demonstrates increased profitability in banking activities.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned and interest costs paid, expressed as a percentage of interest-earning assets.
kpis.description: Net interest margin improved in 2025 due to better rate management and an increase in interest-earning assets.
kpis.signal: 10 basis point increase, indicating improved profitability in banking operations.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Income generated from the spread between interest received on loans and interest paid on deposits.
kpis.description: Net interest income increased in 2025, driven by higher customer lending.
kpis.signal: 8% year-on-year growth, supported by a larger asset base.

kpis.name: Profit Before Tax
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from operations before tax deductions.
kpis.description: Profit before tax amounted to £6,661 million in 2025.
kpis.signal: Strong profit before tax in 2025, reflecting effective cost and risk management.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank, including loans, investments, and cash.
kpis.signal: Very high total assets, consistent with a major UK retail bank.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of full-time employees in the group.
kpis.description: The group employed 60,061 full-time staff in 2025.
kpis.signal: Large workforce, reflecting the size of the branch and service network.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key measure of financial strength, assessing core equity capital against risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio stood at 14.0% in 2025, indicating a strong capital position.
kpis.signal: High CET1 ratio, well above regulatory requirements, confirming capital strength.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €95.14 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €56.66 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and sanction risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of the Regulatory and legal risks section with strong language ("substantial regulation and oversight", "material adverse effect"). High intensity: unpredictable financial impacts and insufficient provisions explicitly mentioned. Stable trend but major categorical weight for a systemic bank.

risks.title: AML/CFT compliance and sanction risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed as a distinct risk in the Regulatory and legal risks section. Moderate language but area highly scrutinized by regulators. Upward trend: geopolitical context (sanctions) and globally strengthened anti-money laundering efforts. Growing weight for international banks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and technological failures
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in Business and operational risks ("cybercrime and technological failure"). Moderate language but critical area for a major digital bank ("largest digital bank in the UK"). Upward trend: increasing cyber threats. High weight due to complex IT infrastructure and digital dependency.

risks.title: Operational risks and third-party resilience
risks.score_rationale: First risk listed in Business and operational risks with strong language ("failure to build sufficient resilience"). Includes reliance on third-party services. Stable trend but major structural weight. COVID crisis and recent disruptions have reinforced regulatory focus on operational resilience.

risks.title: Intense competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in Business and operational risks ("competitive environments"). Moderate language but highly competitive UK context (fintech, challenger banks, neobanks). Upward trend: accelerated digitalization and new entrants. High weight for traditional banks facing disruption.

risks.title: Conduct and reputational risks
risks.score_rationale: Listed as a distinct risk ("conduct risk") in Business and operational risks. Moderate language but Lloyds' history (LIBOR, PPI) creates high sensitivity. Stable trend but major reputational weight. Any conduct incident affects customer trust and regulatory scrutiny.

risks.title: ESG and climate change risks
risks.score_rationale: Listed in Business and operational risks ("ESG matters, climate change and human rights"). Moderate language but upward trend: climate regulation (TCFD, EU taxonomy) and growing ESG pressures. Increasing weight for UK banks. Financial and non-financial impacts mentioned.

risks.title: Strategic execution and digital transformation
risks.score_rationale: Listed as a distinct risk ("fail to execute strategic change initiatives"). Moderate language but context of major transformation (digitalization, ring-fencing). Stable trend but high operational weight. Expected benefits may not materialize.
